hero.description: Explore, interact, and experiment with complex engineering concepts through immersive virtual experiences built for the modern learner.

threeCards.heading: Explore the building blocks of every circuit
threeCards.body: From breadboard to LED to resistor — hands-on 3D interaction with the fundamentals of electronics.

breadboard.body: The solderless breadboard is the starting point for every ECE prototype — snap in components, route jumper wires, and iterate without soldering.

resistor.body: Resistors limit current and set voltage levels. Read the four colour bands — orange, orange, brown, gold — to identify the value and tolerance.

led.body: A light-emitting diode converts current directly into light. Polarity matters: the longer anode lead goes to positive, the flat-side cathode to ground.

capacitor.heading: Capacitor
capacitor.body: Capacitors store and release charge. Essential for filtering, timing, and energy storage applications.
